sentences.en: We took a ferry from the island to the mainland.
sentences.zh: 我们从岛上乘渡船去了 mainland。

sentences.en: In the morning I'm taking the first ferry to Greece.
sentences.zh: 早上我要乘最早一班渡轮去希腊。

sentences.en: Many people died when a large South Korean ferry sank.
sentences.zh: 一艘韩国大型渡轮沉没时，很多人丧生。

senses.zh: （乘渡船）渡过；用渡船运送；空运 -
